editorial.blurb: El Gallo Bravo is an authentic taqueria in Avondale where owner pride shines through in every handmade dish, from fresh-mashed guacamole to perfectly seasoned tacos.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night for the breakfast burrito after a night out, or grab a seat at the counter to watch the staff hand-make the guacamole—the kitchen is spotless and worth observing.
